# v2.0.55

## Production Release Checklist Packaging

- Added `PRODUCTION_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md` as the standard checklist for every production compilation.
- Added GitHub upload, tag, release-notes, changelog, `.env`, production upload path, service restart, smoke-check, and rollback tasks.
- Updated the post-build package so each `dist/server-update-<version>.zip` includes `.env`, `.env.example`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `RELEASE_NOTES-v<version>.md`, `PRODUCTION_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md`, `RX-Manager.bat`, `OPERATIONS_MANUAL.md`, `DEFERRED-ITEMS.txt`, `install-service.ps1`, and `uninstall-service.ps1`.

## Notes

- Real `.env` remains ignored by Git. It is copied only into the local build output and production package.
- Use the checklist's production machine/path fields to record the target location for each deployment.
